chunks: As for what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Faḍālah, from Abān, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

My father used to say: ‘The hadd of the slave is half the hadd of the free person.’ So this report is general, and it is permissible to specify it by the hadd of zina, and we have already explained what necessitates specifying it.

key_terms.الزِّنَى: unlawful sexual intercourse as a hadd offense
key_terms.الْحُرِّ: the free person in contrast to the slave
key_terms.الْخَبَرُ: the report or hadith being discussed
key_terms.الْمَمْلُوكِ: the slave or owned person subject to legal rulings
key_terms.تَخْصِيصُهُ: its specification or restriction from generality

ai.seo_question: Is the hadd punishment for a slave always half that of a free person in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This report states a general legal principle that the prescribed hadd punishment for a slave is half that of a free person. It also notes that this general ruling may be specified in the case of zina, indicating juristic qualification within the application of hadd penalties.
